patch.value: Make every failing health verdict self-indexing and attach gate severity to findings

GH-1001 shows ok:false can coexist with checks that appear healthy because the deciding provenance warning lives only in a distant top-level array. Add a compact failed_because contract adjacent to the verdict, attach every warning to an owning or synthetic check, distinguish advisory from gate-failing findings, and require executable remediation for every failing class.

Every ok:false health payload names its deciding codes beside ok; every warning is indexed by a check and declares advisory or gate_failing severity; every gate-failing code has executable remediation or an explicit safe-disposition refusal; compact and full JSON/TOON projections preserve the verdict explanation; GH-1001 is linked in evidence
